 Sedgwick County announces road closures, parking plan for presidential visit Monday 
 By Angela Smith Published : Oct. 17, 2026 at 9:14 PM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WICHITA, Kan. (KWCH) - The Sedgwick County Sheriff’s Office is advising drivers and event attendees of temporary road closures, parking restrictions and transportation arrangements ahead of President Donald Trump’s visit on Monday, Oct. 19.
 The following roads will be closed to all traffic from 9 a.m. until approximately 8 p.m. Monday:
 Broadway between 77th Street North and 85th Street North 
 Arena Drive between 77th Street North and Briar Rose Lane 
 Parking at Heartland Credit Union Arena will be limited. Attendees must access arena parking from 85th Street North via Arena Drive. Drivers will not be able to access the arena from 77th Street North.
 WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW 
 Additional overflow parking will be available at the northwest parking lot of Gilley’s Park City Gambling Hall, 1500 E. 77th St. North. Shuttle buses will transport attendees from Gilley’s to the arena.
 Following the event, attendees returning to Gilley’s can board shuttle buses on the south side of the arena.
 The sheriff’s office released a map identifying the affected roadways and the designated free speech zone.
 The sheriff’s office encourages drivers to plan ahead, allow additional travel time and use alternate routes to avoid delays. Drivers should follow posted traffic signs and directions from law enforcement.
